40000447.author: पदार्थः
40000447.content: अथ after that, संवत्सरे when one year's time, पूर्णे (सति) was completed, तस्मिन् when that, तुरङ्गमे sacrificial horse, प्राप्ते (सति) had returned, सरय्वा: of river Sarayu, उत्तरे तीरे on the northern bank, राज्ञ: यज्ञश्च sacrifice by the king, अभ्यवर्तत commenced.

40000447.author: Translation
40000447.content: After completion of one year when the sacrificial horse had returned, the sacrifice by the king (Dasaratha) commenced on the northern bank of river Sarayu.

40000448.author: पदार्थः
40000448.content: सुमहात्मन: of the exceedingly magnanimous, अस्य राज्ञ: this king's, अश्वमेधे महायज्ञे Aswamedha sacrifice, द्विजर्षभा: best among brahmins, ऋष्यशृङ्गम् Rsyasringa, पुरस्कृत्य led by, कर्म चक्रु: performed the rituals.

40000448.author: Translation
40000448.content: The best of brahmins led by Rsyasringa performed the rituals of aswamedha organised by the exceedingly magnanimous king.

40000449.author: पदार्थः
40000449.content: वेदपारगा: scholars who mastered vedas fully, याजका: chief priests, विधिवत् in consonance with tradition and scriptures, कर्म tasks, कुर्वन्ति carried out, यथाविधि in conformity with duties laid down in vedas, यथान्यायम् according to law, शास्त्रत: as laid down in scriptures, परिक्रामन्ति move about (officiated).

40000449.author: Translation
40000449.content: The chief priests, masters of the Vedas, conducted the rituals in consonance with traditions and scriptures. They officiated in conformity with duties laid down in the Vedas and according to law.

40000450.author: पदार्थः
40000450.content: द्विजा: brahmins, प्रवर्ग्यम् Pravargya (a particular part of the sacrifice), शास्त्रत: according to scriptures, कृत्वा having done, तथैव and, उपसदम् Upasada (another part of the sacrifice), विधिवत् as per tradition, अधिकम् still other, सर्वं कर्म ceremonies, शास्त्रत: according to ordinance, चक्रु: performed.

40000450.author: Translation
40000450.content: Brahmins performed pravargya and upasada and other ceremonies as per the scriptures and traditions.

40000451.author: पदार्थः
40000451.content: तत: thereafter, मुनिपुङ्गवा: eminent ascetics, हृष्टा: rejoiced in their hearts, अभिपूज्य worshipping those celestial beings, प्रातस्सवनपूर्वाणि starting with Pratah savanadi (morning ablutions etc), कर्माणि rituals, यथाविधि as prescribed, चक्रु: performed.

40000451.author: Translation
40000451.content: Thereafter the eminent ascetics, rejoicing in their hearts performed the worship (of celestial beings) and conducted the prescribed rituals starting with morning ablutions etc.

40000452.author: पदार्थः
40000452.content: ऐन्द्रश्च Indra's portion of Havis (oblations of clarified butter), विधिवत् according to tradition, दत्त: offered, अनघ: faultless or pure, राजा च Soma plant (acid juice of this plant mixed with clarified butter offered in libations to the gods), अभिषुत: was pressed for extracting juice, माध्यन्दिनम् ablutions to be performed during midday, सवनम् Savanam, यथाक्रमम् according to the order, प्रावर्तत took place.

40000452.author: Translation
40000452.content: Havis was duly offered to Indra daily. The juice was extracted in the morning by pressing the soma plant. Midday ablutions were performed. All in proper sequence.

40000453.author: पदार्थः
40000453.content: तथा in the same way, ते ब्राह्मणपुङ्गवा: those eminent brahmins, शास्त्रत: in conformity with Shastras, दृष्ट्वा having seen, सुमहात्मन: of the exceedingly noble, अस्य राज्ञ: this king's, तृतीयसवनं चैव third pressing of the Soma in the evening, चक्रु: performed.

40000453.author: Translation
40000453.content: Those exceedingly noble and eminent brahmins performed third pressing of the soma, in conformity with the sastras.

40000454.author: पदार्थः
40000454.content: तत्र in that sacrifice, आहुतम् omissions in the offerings, नाभूत् did not take place, किञ्चन any thing, स्खलितम् defects or mistakes, नाभूत् did not take place, सर्वम् everything, ब्रह्मवत् with mantras (prayers), दृश्यते appeared, क्षेमयुक्तम् in a safe manner, चक्रिरे हि performed.

40000454.author: Translation
40000454.content: There were no omissions in the offerings nor any lappes in the performance. Everything was done through recitation of mantras and in a wholesome way.

40000455.author: पदार्थः
40000455.content: तेषु in those, अहस्सु days, श्रान्त: a tired man, क्षुधितो वापि or hungry one, न दृश्यते was not to be seen, तत्र there, अविद्वान् not learned, ब्राह्मण: brahmin, न दृश्यते not to be seen, तथा similarly, अशतानुचर: a man followed by less than hundred people, न दृश्यते was not seen.

40000455.author: Translation
40000455.content: During the days (of sacrifice) none felt tired or hungry. There was no brahmin who was not learned or had less than a hundred followers (or disciples).

40000456.author: पदार्थः
40000456.content: नित्यम् continually, ब्राह्मणा: brahmanas, भुञ्जते are eating, नाथवन्तश्च those who have  masters, भुञ्जते are eating, तापसाश्चापि ascetics, भुञ्जते are eating, तथा and, श्रमणा: monks, भुञ्जते are eating.

40000456.author: Translation
40000456.content: During that period brahmanas as well as those who have masters, (the sudras), ascetics and monks had enough to eat.

40000457.author: पदार्थः
40000457.content: वृद्धा: aged persons, व्याधिताश्चैव sick people, स्त्रिय: women, तथैव च and also, बाला: children, अनिशम् continually, भुञ्जमानानाम् although feasting, तृप्ति: full satisfaction, न उपलभ्यते is not acheeved.

40000457.author: Translation
40000457.content: The aged, the sick, women and also children ate there and knew no limit to their enjoyment.

40000458.author: पदार्थः
40000458.content: अन्नम् food, दीयतां दीयताम् may be given, may be given, विविधानि various kinds of, वासांसि च clothes also, इति in this manner, तत्र in that sacrificial ground, सञ्चोदिता: persuaded by, अनेकश: profusely, तथा in the same manner, चक्रु: performed.

40000458.author: Translation
40000458.content: "Give food, give, various kinds of clothes" echoed the organisers. And they (in charge of distribution) did.

40000459.author: पदार्थः
40000459.content: तत्र there, तदा then, विधिवत् in accordance with scriptures, सिद्धस्य kept ready, अन्नकूटा: heaps of food, बहव: many, पर्वतोपमा: looking like mountains, दिवसे दिवसे every day, दृश्यन्ते were to be seen.

40000459.author: Translation
40000459.content: There, could be seen day after day heaps of nicely cooked food, looking like mountains.

40000460.author: पदार्थः
40000460.content: महात्मन: Illustrious king's, तस्मिन् यज्ञे in that sacrifice, नानादेशात् from various countries, अनुप्राप्ता: arrived, पुरुषा: men, तथा and, स्त्रीगणा: women in groups, अन्नपानै: with food and drink, सुविहिता were well entertained.

40000460.author: Translation
40000460.content: Men and women who had come from various countries to that sacrifice were entertained with food and drink by the magnanimous (king).

40000461.author: पदार्थः
40000461.content: द्विजर्षभा: the twiceborns, विधिवत् cooked in prescribed manner, साधु good (delicious), अन्नम् food, प्रशंसन्ति praised, राघव: son of Raghu, Dasaratha, अहो Ah, तृप्ता: स्म fully satisfied, ते to you, भद्रम् prosperity, इति such words, शुश्राव were heard.

40000461.author: Translation
40000461.content: Brahmins having tasted the delicious food cooked in prescribed manner, praised saying "Ah We are fully satisfied. Prosperity to you". Such were the words heard by king Dasaratha.

40000462.author: पदार्थः
40000462.content: स्वलङ्कृता: well dressed, पुरुषा: men, ब्राह्मणान् brahmins, पर्यवेषयन् served with, सुमृष्टमणिकुण्डला: wearing pendents bedecked with shining jewels, अन्ये च some others, तान् them, उपासते assisted.

40000462.author: Translation
40000462.content: While brahmins were being served with food by welldressed men, some others wearing pendents studded with shining jewels assisted them.

40000463.author: पदार्थः
40000463.content: तदा then, वाग्मिन: eloquent, धीरा: sagacious, विप्रा: brahmins, तदा then, कर्मान्तरे in between ceremonies, परस्परजिगीषया mutually desirous of victory, बहून् various, हेतुवादान् disputations, प्राहु: च engaged.

40000463.author: Translation
40000463.content: In the interval between ceremonies, eloquent and sagacious brahmins were engaged in various disputations, desirous of victory.

40000464.author: पदार्थः
40000464.content: संस्तरे in the sacrifice, कुशला: skilful, द्विजा: brahmins, दिवसे दिवसे every day, तत्र there, प्रचोदिता: persuaded by sage Vasistha, सर्वकर्माणि all their duties, यथाशास्त्रम् as per tradition, चक्रु: performed.

40000464.author: Translation
40000464.content: Every day in that sacrifice brahmins, skilful in rituals, persuaded (by sage Vasishta), performed all their duties as per tradition.

40000465.author: पदार्थः
40000465.content: अत्र in this sacrificial pavillion, अषडङ्गवित् not versed in six vedangas, नासीत् not there, अव्रत: unfaithful to vowed observances, न not there, अबहुश्रुत: not learned in many shastras, न not there, तस्य राज्ञ: that king's, सदस्या: assistants at a sacrifice, नावादकुशला: not skilful in disputations in shastras, न वै not there.

40000465.author: Translation
40000465.content: Here (in this sacrificial pavillion), there was none who was not versed in six Vedangas, not true to vows, not learned in many sastras nor adept in discussions (on sastras).

40000466.author: पदार्थः
40000466.content: तस्मिन् in that sacrifice, यूपोच्छ्रये in erecting sacrificial posts, प्राप्ते (सति) when the time, बैल्वा: bilva wood, षट् six, तथा and, बिल्वसहिता: along with bilva posts, तावन्त: as many, खादिरा: Khadira, तथा and, पर्णिन: च having leaves, अपरे some more posts, एक: one, श्लेष्मातकमय: made of Sleshmataka, तथा and, देवदारुमय: made of trees of Devadaru, तत्र there, द्वौ two, बाहुव्यस्तपरिग्रहावेव at a distance of two outstretched hands, विहितौ were erected.

40000466.author: Translation
40000466.content: When the time came to erect sacrificial posts, six posts, each made of bilva, khadira, parni, sleshmataka and two of devadaru wood, with a distance of two outstretched hands between them were erected.

40000467.author: पदार्थः
40000467.content: तस्मिन् in that sacrifice, यूपोच्छ्रये inerecting sacrificial posts, प्राप्ते (सति) when the time has come  nearer, बैल्वा: Bilva wood, षट् six, तथा and, बिल्वसहिता: along with Bilva posts, तावन्त: as many, खादिरा: Khadira, तथा and, पर्णिन: च having Parnas leaves, अपरे some more posts, एक: one, श्लेष्मातकमय: made of Sleshmataka, तथा and, देवदारुमय: made of trees of Devadaru, तत्र there, द्वौ two, बाहुव्यस्तपरिग्रहावेव at a distance of two outstretched hands, विहितौ were erected.

40000467.author: Translation
40000467.content: When the time came to erect sacrificial posts, six posts each made of bilva and khadira wood and many made of parni wood along, one of sleshmataka and two of devadaru wood, with a distance of two outstretched hands between them were erected.

40000468.author: पदार्थः
40000468.content: शास्त्रज्ञै: by the knowers of shastras, यज्ञकोविदै: who well versed in performance of sacrifice, कारिता: were made, एते सर्वे एव all these posts, तस्य यज्ञस्य of that sacrifice, शोभार्थम् for elegance, काञ्चनालङ्कृता: decorated with gold, अभवन् became.

40000468.author: Translation
40000468.content: All these posts were prepared by knowers of sastras and by those wellversed in the performance of sacrifices. They were decorated with gold to add elegance to the sacrifice.

40000469.author: पदार्थः
40000469.content: एकविंशत्यरत्नय: measuring twenty one 'Aratni ' (distance from elbow to the tip of little finger), ते those, एकविंशतियूपा: twenty one posts, एकविंशद्भि: by twenty one, वासोभि: pieces of cloth, एकैकम् one for each post, समलङ्कृता: well decorated.

40000469.author: Translation
40000469.content: These twentyone sacrificial posts, each measuring twentyone 'aratni' height, were welldecorated wrapped in a piece of cloth.

40000470.author: पदार्थः
40000470.content: सर्वे all of them, शिल्पिभि: by the sculptors, सुकृता: were well carved, दृढा: strong, अष्टाश्रय: having eight sides, श्लक्ष्णरूपसमन्विता: had finely finished surfaces, सर्वे all those, विधिवत् as per tradition, विन्यस्ता: were erected.

40000470.author: Translation
40000470.content: All those posts, strong with eight sides and finely finished surfaces, wellcarved  by sculptors were duly erected.

40000471.author: पदार्थः
40000471.content: वासोभि: with cloths, आच्छादिता: were covered, पुष्पै: with flowers, गन्धैश्च with sandalwood paste, भूषिता: decorated, ते those posts, दीप्तिमन्त: glowing, दिवि in the sky, सप्तर्षय: seven sages, यथा in a similar manner, विराजन्ते illuminated.

40000471.author: Translation
40000471.content: Decorated with flowers and sandal paste and covered with cloths, stood the  bright sacrificial posts shining like seven sages in the sky.

40000472.author: पदार्थः
40000472.content: तत्र there, यथान्यायम् as per shastras, प्रमाणत: with standard measurement, इष्टका: bricks, कारिता were made, शुल्बकर्मणि in the science of construction using a measuring rope, कुशलै: accomplished, ब्राह्मणै: brahmins, अग्नि: sacrificial fire place, चित: gathered and laid bricks were prepared as per standard measurment mentioned in shastras.

40000472.author: Translation
40000472.content: The sacrificial fireplace was constructed with bricks with standard measurement by brahmins who were experts in the art of measuring land with a string or single strand.

40000473.author: पदार्थः
40000473.content: कुशलै: by the skilled, द्विजै: brahmins, रुक्मपक्ष: golden winged, त्रिगुण: thrice, अष्टादशात्मक: eighteen in number, गरुड: like eagle, राजसिंहस्य of Dasaratha who was lion among kings, सचित्य: sacrificial altar, सञ्चित: was erected.

40000473.author: Translation
40000473.content: That sacrificial altar of the lion among kings, (Dasaratha), erected by welltrained brahmins was in the shape of the golden winged 'Garuda' it had three ranges and thrice as many fireplaces i.e eighteen in number.

40000474.author: पदार्थः
40000474.content: तत्र there, यथाशास्त्रम् as per tradition, प्रचोदिता: prompted, पशव: animals, उरगा: serpants, पक्षिणश्चैव birds also, तत्तत् that respective, दैवतम् deity,  उद्दिश्य intended for, नियुक्ता: were fastened.

40000474.author: Translation
40000474.content: Animals, serpents and birds were kept ready after the sastras intended (for sacrifice) for those respective deities.

40000475.author: पदार्थः
40000475.content: तदा then, शामित्रे तु in the act of killing animals, तत्र there, हय: horse, तथा and, ये other, जलचरा: aquatic animals, एतत्सर्वम् all these, ऋत्विग्भि: by chief priests, शास्त्रत: in accordance with tradition, नियुक्तम् tied up.

40000475.author: Translation
40000475.content: When the time came to sacrifice the animals, the chief priests, in accordance with tradition, tied up the horse and all the aquatic animals to the sacrificial posts.

40000476.author: पदार्थः
40000476.content: तदा then, तत्र there, पशूनाम् of animals, त्रिशतम् three hundred, तस्य राज्ञ: that king's, अश्वरत्नोत्तमम् the excellent of the horses from the stables, यूपेषु to the sacrificial posts, नियतम् was bound.

40000476.author: Translation
40000476.content: Three hundred animals and the jewel of the horses (from the stables) belonging to king Dasaratha were bound to the sacrificial posts.

40000477.author: पदार्थः
40000477.content: तत्र there, कौशल्या Kausalya, तम् that, हयम् horse, समन्तत: from all sides, परिचर्य having worshipped worship, परमया with immense, मुदा glee, त्रिभि: by three strokes of, कृपाणै: scimitar, एनम् this, विशशास severed.

40000477.author: Translation
40000477.content: Kausalya, with immense glee having gone round and worshipped that horse, severed it with three strokes of scimitar.

40000478.author: पदार्थः
40000478.content: तदा then, कौशल्या Kausalya, सुस्थितेन चेतसा with a stable mind, धर्मकाम्यया with devotion to duty, पतत्रिणा सार्थम् near that horse, एकाम् one, रजनीम् night, अवसत् spent.

40000478.author: Translation
40000478.content: Kausalya, in her devotion to duty and with a happy state of mind, passed one night near that horse.

40000479.author: पदार्थः
40000479.content: होता Hota, अध्वर्यु: Adhvaryu, तथा and, उद्गाता Udgata, महिष्या with Mahishi (principal queen at the time of coronation), परिवृत्त्या च (overlooked wife) Parivritti, वावाताम् (a courtesan) Vavaata, अपराम् (attender on the king) other woman (known as Palakali), हस्तेन with hand, समयोजयन् touched.

40000479.author: Translation
40000479.content: Hota, Adhvaryu and Udgata arranged Mahishi, Parivritti, Vavaata and another woman known as Palakali to touch (keep the company of) the sacrificial horse.

40000480.author: पदार्थः
40000480.content: नियतेन्द्रिय: a man of restrained senses, परमसम्पन्न: very rich in the knowledge of scriptures, ऋत्विक् official priest, तस्य that, पतत्रिण: horse's, वपाम् marrow, उद्धृत्य having removed, शास्त्रत: according to tradition, श्रपयामास cooked.

40000480.author: Translation
40000480.content: The official priest, highly knowledgeable in scriptures and having restrained senses, removed the marrow from the horse and cooked it according to tradition.

40000481.author: पदार्थः
40000481.content: नराधिप: king Dasaratha, यथाकालम् in an appropriate time, यथान्यायम् in agreement with the scriptures, आत्मन: his own, पापम् sins, निर्णुदन् while getting rid of, वपाया: of the  marrow, धूमगन्धम् good odour of the smoke, जिघ्रति स्म inhaled.

40000481.author: Translation
40000481.content: The king at appropriate time and in agreement with the scriptures inhaled the odour of the smoke (from the burnt marrow) and absolved himself of his sins.

40000482.author: पदार्थः
40000482.content: हयस्य horse's, यानि अङ्गानि those limbs, तानि सर्वाणि all of them, समन्त्रा: with prayers, षोडश ऋत्विज: sixteen officiating priests, ब्राह्मणा: brahmins, विधिवत् as per the customs,  अग्नौ in the fire, प्रास्यन्ति offered.

40000482.author: Translation
40000482.content: The sixteen officiating priests (brahmins) offered all the horse's limbs with prayers as per the customs.

40000483.author: पदार्थः
40000483.content: अन्येषाम् of other, यज्ञानाम् sacrifices, हवि: oblations, प्लक्षशाखासु in the brahches of Plaksha tree, क्रियते was offered, अश्वमेधस्य यज्ञस्य of Aswamedha sacrifice, भाग: one portion of Havis, वैतस: cane creeper, इष्यते chosen.

40000483.author: Translation
40000483.content: In other sacrifices oblations are offered with branches of a plaksha tree but in Aswamedha a branch of cane creeper is chosen instead.

40000484.author: पदार्थः
40000484.content: ब्राह्मणै: by brahmins, कल्पसूत्रेण according to Kalpa sutra, अश्वमेध: Aswamedha, त्र्यह: having three days duration, सङ्ख्यात: is reckoned, तस्य of that, प्रथमम् first, अह: day, चतुष्टोम: chatushtoma, परिकल्पितम् planned.

40000484.author: Translation
40000484.content: According to Kalpa sutra, aswamedha in conducted for three days. In the first day, chatushtoma is arranged.

40000485.author: पदार्थः
40000485.content: द्वितीयम् on the second day, उक्थ्यम् Ukthya, तथा and, उत्तरम् on the following day, अतिरात्रम् Atiraatra, सङ्ख्यातम् is declared, तत्र In that sacrifice, शास्त्रदर्शनात् according to scriptural knowledge, विहिता: imposed, बहव: many, कारिता: were performed.

40000485.author: Translation
40000485.content: On the second day Ukthya and on the third day Atiraatra were performed. Many sacrifices fixed according to the scriptures were also performed.

40000486.author: पदार्थः
40000486.content: ज्योतिष्टोमायुषी Jyotishtoma and Ayuryaga, एवम् and, अतिरात्रौ in Atiratri, विनिर्मितौ were advised, अभिजित् Abhijit, विश्वजित् Viswajit, एवम् and, अप्तोर्याम: Aptoryama, महाक्रतु: great sacrifice, were performed.

40000486.author: Translation
40000486.content: Jyotishtoma and Ayuryaga in Atiratra, Abhijit, Viswajit and Aptoryama ceremonies constituting the great sacrifice were performed in the prescribed manner.

40000487.author: पदार्थः
40000487.content: स्वकुलवर्धन: promoter of his dynasty, राजा Dasaratha, होत्रे to Hotar, प्राचीं दिशम् easten region, ददौ gave, अध्वर्यवे to Adhvaryu, प्रतीचीम् western side, ब्रह्मणे to Brahma, दक्षिणां दिशम् southern region, तथा and, उद्गात्रे to Udgata, उदीचीम् northern region, पुरा long ago, स्वयम्भूविहिते prescribed by Brahma, हयमेधे महायज्ञे in the mighty horsesacrifice, एषा this, दक्षिणा offering, विनिर्मिता is fixed.

40000487.author: Translation
40000487.content: In order to promote his dynasty, king Dasaratha gave away eastern region to Hotar, western region to Adhvaryu, southern region to Brahma and northern region to Udgata. These offerings were made in accordance with theprescriptions by Brahma long all.

40000488.author: पदार्थः
40000488.content: स्वकुलवर्धन: promoter of his dynasty, राजा Dasaratha, होत्रे to Hotar, प्राचीं दिशम् easten region, ददौ gave, अध्वर्यवे to Adhvaryu, प्रतीचीम् western side, ब्रह्मणे to Brahma, दक्षिणां दिशम् southern region, तथा and, उद्गात्रे to Udgata, उदीचीम् northern region, पुरा long ago, स्वयम्भूविहिते prescribed by Brahma, हयमेधे महायज्ञे in the mighty horsesacrifice, एषा this, दक्षिणा offering, विनिर्मिता is fixed.

40000488.author: Translation
40000488.content: In order to promote his dynasty, king Dasaratha gave away eastern region to Hotar, western region to Adhvaryu, southern region to Brahma and northern region to Udgata. These offerings were made in accordance with theprescriptions by Brahma long all.

40000489.author: पदार्थः
40000489.content: पुरुषर्षभ: best among men, राजा king Dasaratha, कुलवर्धन: upholder of his dynasty, क्रतुम् समाप्य having concluded the sacrifice, तदा then, न्यायत: according to law, तां धराम् that  earth, ऋत्विग्भ्य: for priests, ददौ offered.

40000489.author: Translation
40000489.content: The king best among men and upholder of his dynasty, having concluded the sacrifice according to law, offered this entire earth as gift to priests.

40000490.author: पदार्थः
40000490.content: सर्वे all, ऋत्विजस्तु priests on their part, गतकल्मषम् purged of all sins, राजानम् the king, अब्रुवन् said, भवान् you, एक:एव you alone, कृत्स्नाम् entire, महीम् earth, रक्षितुमर्हति are worthy of protection.

40000490.author: Translation
40000490.content: But all the priests said to the king purged of his sins, "O Lord of men you alone are capable of protecting this earth".

40000491.author: पदार्थः
40000491.content: भूमिप O Ruler of the earth, भूम्या with earth, अस्माकम् for us, न कार्यम् have nothing to do, पालने in ruling, न हि शक्ता: we are not capable, वयम् we, नित्यम् constantly, स्वाध्यायकरणे in  studying of vedas, रता: हि are dedicated indeed, भवान् you, इह in the matter of this offering, किञ्चित् whatever, निष्क्रयम् in lieu value, प्रयच्छतु may confer.

40000491.author: Translation
40000491.content: "O ruler of the earth We are constantly engaged in the study of the Vedas. We are not capable of ruling the earth and we cannot do anything with its possession. Give some other charity in lieu of that.

40000492.author: पदार्थः
40000492.content: नरश्रेष्ठ O best of men, मणिरत्नम् a precious gem, सुवर्णं वा or gold, गाव: cows, यद्वा or else,  समुद्यतम् is ready, तत् that, प्रयच्छ give, धरण्या with earth, प्रयोजनं न no use.

40000492.author: Translation
40000492.content: O best of men give us gems or gold or cows or whichever is readily available. We have no use with this earth".

40000493.author: पदार्थः
40000493.content: नरपति: lord of men, नृप: king Dasaratha, वेदपारगै: by scholars who were well learned in vedas, ब्राह्मणै: by brahmins, एवम् in this manner, उक्त: having spoken, तेभ्य: for them, गवां दश शतसहस्राणि ten hundred thousands, सुवर्णस्य gold, शतकोटी: hundred crores, रजतस्य of  silver, चतुर्गुणम् four times as much, ददौ bestowed.

40000493.author: Translation
40000493.content: Lord of men, the king having been thus addressed by brahmins who were wellversed in the Vedas, bestowed on them ten hundred thousand cows, a hundred crore of gold coins and four times as much in silver coins.

40000494.author: पदार्थः
40000494.content: नरपति: lord of men, नृप: king Dasaratha, वेदपारगै: by scholars who were well learned in vedas, ब्राह्मणै: by brahmins, एवम् in this manner, उक्त: having spoken, तेभ्य: for them, गवां दश शतसहस्राणि ten hundred thousands, सुवर्णस्य gold, शतकोटी: hundred crores, रजतस्य of  silver, चतुर्गुणम् four times as much, ददौ bestowed.

40000494.author: Translation
40000494.content: Lord of men, the king having been thus addressed by brahmins who were wellversed in the Vedas, bestowed on them ten hundred thousand cows, a hundred crore of gold coins and four times as much in silver coins.

40000495.author: पदार्थः
40000495.content: तत: thereafter, ऋत्विज: priests, सर्वे all, सहिता: together, वसु wealth, ऋश्यशृङ्गाय मुनये for sage Rsyasringa, धीमते to the man endowed with prudence, वसिष्ठाय to vasistha,  प्रददु: gave.

40000495.author: Translation
40000495.content: All the priests collectively offered that wealth to sage Rsyasringa and Vasishta endowed with prudence.

40000496.author: पदार्थः
40000496.content: तत: then, सुप्रीतमनस: highly pleased, ते द्विजोत्तमा: those brahmins, सर्वे all, न्यायत: with equity, प्रविभागम् share, कृत्वा having made, भृशम् exceedingly, मुदिता: delighted, प्रत्यूचु:  replied.

40000496.author: Translation
40000496.content: Then those highly pleased brahmins, having distributed that wealth with equity, again said to the king.

40000497.author: पदार्थः
40000497.content: तत: thereafter, तदा then, सुसमाहित: with earnestness, प्रसर्पकैभ्य: to those who have come to see the sacrifice, ब्राह्मणेभ्य: to brahmins, कोटिसंख्यम् one crore of, जाम्बूनदम् gold, ददौ bestowed.

40000497.author: Translation
40000497.content: Thereafter, with earnestness king Dasaratha bestowed a crore of gold coins to brahmins who had come to see the sacrifice.

40000498.author: पदार्थः
40000498.content: अथ there after, राघवनन्दन: Dasaratha, याचमानाय soliciting, कस्मैचित् one such, दरिद्राय poor, द्विजाय brahmin, उत्तमम् excellent, हस्ताभरणम् bracelet, ददौ gave.

40000498.author: Translation
40000498.content: Dasaratha then gave his excellent bracelet to a poor brahmin who solicited alms.

40000499.author: पदार्थः
40000499.content: तत: then, द्विजवत्सल: affectionate towards brahmins, नृपति: king, द्विजेषु when brahmins, प्रीतेषु (सत्सु) were highly pleased, हर्षपर्याकुलेक्षण: with his eyes filled with delight, तेषाम् for them, प्रणामम् अकरोत् bowed low before them.

40000499.author: Translation
40000499.content: When the brahmins were pleased, king Dasaratha who was fond of brahmins bowed to them with his eyes filled with delight.

40000500.author: पदार्थः
40000500.content: अथ there after, उदारस्य of the generous, नृवीरस्य of him who was mighty among men, धरण्याम् on the earth, प्रणतस्य prostrated, तस्य for him, ब्राह्मणै: by brahmins, विधिवत् according to procedure, आशिष: blessings, समुदीरिता: were uttered.

40000500.author: Translation
40000500.content: Brahmins uttered blessings upon the generous king when he prostrated before them according to procedure.

40000501.author: पदार्थः
40000501.content: तत: there after, राजा king Dasaratha, पापापहम् capable of removing sins, स्वर्नयनम् leading to heaven, पार्थिवर्षभै: for monarchs, दुष्करम् incapable of being done, अनुत्तमम् greatest, यज्ञम् sacrifice, प्राप्य having performed, प्रीतमना: cheerful heart.

40000501.author: Translation
40000501.content: Sacrifice destroys sins. It leads to heaven. It is incapable of being done by other monarchs. King Dasaratha was very much pleased after performing this great sacrifice.

40000502.author: पदार्थः
40000502.content: तत: there after, दशरथ: राजा king Dasaratha, तदा then, ऋष्यशृङ्गम् addressing Rsyasringa, अब्रवीत् said, सुव्रत O Adherent of vows, कुलस्य of the race, वर्धनम् continuity, त्वम् you,कर्तुम् to do, अर्हसि deserve.

40000502.author: Translation
40000502.content: King Dasaratha then addressing Rsyasringa said "O Adherent of vows you can help the continuity of my race".

40000503.author: पदार्थः
40000503.content: द्विजसत्तम: best of brahmins, तथेति be it so, राजानम् addressing king Dasaratha, उवाच said,  राजन् O king, ते to you, कुलोद्वहा: perpetuating race, चत्वार: four, सुता: sons, भविष्यन्ति will be born.

40000503.author: Translation
40000503.content: Rsyasringa, the best of brahmins, addressing the king said, "O King Let it be. Four sons perpetuating your race will be born to you". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे चतुर्दशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the fourteenth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
